isolation.isolationMethod: Each test creates its own server instance on a random free port via findFreePort(). No shared state between tests.

assertions.title: Gateway starts with valid tsnet auth key

steps.action: Run TestStartDevMode — starts gateway in dev mode on random free port
steps.expected: Server starts, HTTP GET /healthz returns 200 with valid JSON
steps.observed: TestStartDevMode passed (0.20s). HTTP GET to http://127.0.0.1:<port>/healthz returned 200. Response body contained HealthStatus with tsnet=disabled (dev mode), store=ok, tmux=ok. Content-Type: application/json; charset=utf-8.

assertions.title: Gateway persists tsnet state across restarts

steps.action: Run TestStateDirResolution — verifies state dir option stored correctly on server
steps.expected: State directory path is preserved on the server instance
steps.observed: TestStateDirResolution passed (0.21s). Server created with custom state dir, asserted srv.opts.StateDir matches the configured tmpDir value.

steps.action: Run TestAuthKeyError_NoStateNoKey — verifies auth key error when no state exists
steps.expected: Without auth key and empty state dir, returns AuthKeyError
steps.observed: TestAuthKeyError_NoStateNoKey passed. Server.Start(ctx) returned error, and error was asserted to be *AuthKeyError via ErrorAs.

evidence.testOutput:
=== RUN   TestStateDirResolution
--- PASS: TestStateDirResolution (0.21s)
=== RUN   TestAuthKeyError_NoStateNoKey
--- PASS: TestAuthKeyError_NoStateNoKey (0.00s)

assertions.title: Gateway shuts down gracefully on SIGTERM

steps.action: Run TestStartDevMode_GracefulShutdown — starts server, verifies running, cancels context (simulating SIGTERM), verifies clean shutdown
steps.expected: Context cancellation triggers clean shutdown, no error returned, completes within 20s timeout
steps.observed: TestStartDevMode_GracefulShutdown passed (0.20s). Server started, healthz confirmed 200. Context cancelled, shutdown completed cleanly (no error on errCh). Subsequent HTTP GET to same URL failed confirming server stopped.

steps.action: Run TestShutdown_SetsStoppedHealth — verifies health status set to 'stopped' after shutdown
steps.expected: After shutdown, all health fields (tsnet, store, tmux) are 'stopped'
steps.observed: TestShutdown_SetsStoppedHealth passed (0.20s). Pre-shutdown health: store=ok. Post-shutdown health: tsnet=stopped, store=stopped, tmux=stopped.

evidence.testOutput:
=== RUN   TestStartDevMode_GracefulShutdown
--- PASS: TestStartDevMode_GracefulShutdown (0.20s)
=== RUN   TestShutdown_SetsStoppedHealth
--- PASS: TestShutdown_SetsStoppedHealth (0.20s)

assertions.title: Gateway reports actionable error for missing auth key

steps.action: Run TestAuthKeyError — verifies AuthKeyError struct has correct message, envelope format, and hint
steps.expected: Error message mentions missing auth key; envelope data.hint contains TS_AUTHKEY and --ts-authkey; data.state contains state dir path
steps.observed: TestAuthKeyError passed. Error message: 'no Tailscale auth key provided and no existing state'. Envelope data.hint contains 'TS_AUTHKEY' and '--ts-authkey'. data.state = '/tmp/gateway'.

steps.action: Run TestRun_AuthKeyError — verifies Run() returns AuthKeyError when no key and no state
steps.observed: TestRun_AuthKeyError passed. Run() with empty TS_AUTHKEY and temp state dir returned error that asserted as *AuthKeyError via ErrorAs.

steps.action: Run TestAuthKeyError_NoStateNoKey — verifies server.Start returns AuthKeyError without state or key
steps.observed: TestAuthKeyError_NoStateNoKey passed. Server.Start with empty state dir and no auth key returned *AuthKeyError.

evidence.testOutput:
=== RUN   TestAuthKeyError
--- PASS: TestAuthKeyError (0.00s)
=== RUN   TestRun_AuthKeyError
--- PASS: TestRun_AuthKeyError (0.00s)
=== RUN   TestAuthKeyError_NoStateNoKey
--- PASS: TestAuthKeyError_NoStateNoKey (0.00s)

assertions.title: Gateway dev mode allows localhost access

steps.action: Run TestStartDevMode — starts gateway with Dev:true, verifies localhost HTTP works without Tailscale
steps.expected: HTTP server listens on 127.0.0.1:<port>, healthz returns 200, tsnet status is 'disabled' in dev mode
steps.observed: TestStartDevMode passed (0.20s). HTTP GET to http://127.0.0.1:<port>/healthz returned 200. Response JSON showed tsnet='disabled' (confirming tsnet not used in dev mode), store='ok', tmux='ok'.

steps.action: Run TestHandleHealthz_OK — all subsystems ok returns 200 with JSON
steps.expected: HTTP 200, JSON body with tsnet=ok, store=ok, tmux=ok
steps.observed: TestHandleHealthz_OK passed. Status 200, Content-Type application/json; charset=utf-8. Body: tsnet=ok, store=ok, tmux=ok.

steps.action: Run TestHandleHealthz_Degraded — subsystem in 'error' state returns 503
steps.expected: HTTP 503, JSON body shows degraded subsystem
steps.observed: TestHandleHealthz_Degraded passed. Status 503. Body: tsnet=error (degraded subsystem visible in response).

steps.action: Run TestHandleHealthz_Starting — subsystem in 'starting' state returns 200 (not degraded)
steps.observed: TestHandleHealthz_Starting passed. Status 200 returned for 'starting' state.

steps.action: Run TestHandleHealthz_Disabled — subsystem in 'disabled' state returns 200
steps.expected: HTTP 200 (disabled is expected in dev mode, not degraded)
steps.observed: TestHandleHealthz_Disabled passed. Status 200 returned for 'disabled' state.

evidence.testOutput:
=== RUN   TestHandleHealthz_OK
--- PASS: TestHandleHealthz_OK (0.00s)
=== RUN   TestHandleHealthz_Starting
--- PASS: TestHandleHealthz_Starting (0.00s)
=== RUN   TestHandleHealthz_Degraded
--- PASS: TestHandleHealthz_Degraded (0.00s)
=== RUN   TestHandleHealthz_Disabled
--- PASS: TestHandleHealthz_Disabled (0.00s)

summary: Tested 6 assertions via 14 Go test functions. All 6 assertions passed: VAL-GW-001 (gateway starts with valid auth key in dev mode), VAL-GW-002 (state dir resolution and auth key requirements), VAL-GW-003 (graceful shutdown with health status set to stopped), VAL-GW-004 (actionable EARG error with hint for missing auth key), VAL-GW-027 (dev mode localhost HTTP access with tsnet=disabled), VAL-GW-028 (healthz reflects subsystem status with correct HTTP status codes: 200 for ok/starting/disabled, 503 for degraded). Total test execution time: 1.635s.
